display_title: 21-4-2 多种语言如何帮助印度最贫困的学童？

sentences.en: The crowded and bustling streets of Delhi teem with life.
sentences.zh: 在德里，拥挤热闹的街头处处透着生气。

sentences.en: Stop to listen and, above the din of rickshaws and buses, you'll hear a multitude of languages, as more than 20 million people go about their daily lives.
sentences.zh: 停下来听听，在人力车和公交车的喧闹声之上，你会听到各种各样的语言；两千多万人正各自忙着日常生活。

sentences.en: Many were born and raised here, and many millions more have recently made India's capital their home, having moved from surrounding neighbourhoods, cities and states or across the country, often in the hope of gaining better jobs and a better life.
sentences.zh: 许多人在这里出生、长大。还有数百万人近来把印度首都当成了自己的家，他们从附近的社区、城市、邦或国内遥远的地方迁来，往往是希望找到更好的工作，过上更好的生活。

sentences.en: Some arrive speaking fluent Hindi, the dominant language in Delhi (and the official language of government), but many arrive speaking any number of India's 22 officially recognised languages, let alone the hundreds of regional languages in a country of more than 1.3 billion people.
sentences.zh: 有些人来时就说一口流利的印地语，这是德里的主要语言，也是政府公务用语。但还有许多人说的是印度22种获官方承认的语言中的某一种；更不用说，在这个超过13亿人口的国家，还有数百种地方语言。

sentences.en: A team of researchers led by Professor Ianthi Tsimpli of Cambridge University is currently working on a project collecting data on 1,000 primary-age children in Delhi and the cities of Hyderabad and Bihar.
sentences.zh: 剑桥大学扬西·齐姆普利教授带领的研究团队正在开展一个项目，收集德里、海得拉巴和比哈尔三地共1,000名小学学龄儿童的数据。

sentences.en: The overriding aim of the four-year project, called 'Multilingualism and Multiliteracy', is to find out why in a country where multilingualism is so common (more than 255 million people in India speak at least two languages, and nearly 90 million speak three or more languages), the many benefits of speaking more than one language, observed in schools in Europe for instance, do not apply to many of India's schoolchildren.
sentences.zh: 这项历时四年的研究名为“多语能力与多语读写能力”，首要目标是解开一个疑问。印度使用多种语言的人如此之多：超过2.55亿人会说至少两种语言，近9,000万人会说三种或更多。然而，会说多种语言的种种益处，例如欧洲学校里观察到的那些，在印度许多学童身上为何没有体现？

sentences.en: 'Each year across India, 600,000 children are tested, and year after year over 50% of children in Standard 5 [ten-year-olds] cannot read a Standard 2 [seven-year-olds] task fluently, and just under 50% of them cannot solve a Standard 2 subtraction task,' says Tsimpli.
sentences.zh: “全印度每年有60万名儿童接受测试。年复一年，超过50%的五年级学生（10岁）连二年级（7岁）的阅读材料都读不流畅，而且还有略低于50%的五年级学生做不出二年级的减法题。”齐姆普利说。

sentences.en: She explains that low educational achievement can lead to many of these students dropping out of school – a problem disproportionately affecting female students.
sentences.zh: 她解释，学业表现不佳可能导致许多学生辍学，而这一问题对女生的影响尤其大。

sentences.en: Tsimpli and her colleagues are investigating whether these low learning outcomes could be caused by an Indian school system where the language that children are taught in often differs from the language used at home.
sentences.zh: 齐姆普利和同事正在调查，孩子们学习成效不佳是否与印度的学校制度有关：学校采用的授课语言，常与孩子在家中使用的语言不同。

sentences.en: The research project, which focuses on 8 to 11-year-old schoolchildren in rural and urban areas, collects data on whether the schoolchildren live in slum* or non-slum areas.
sentences.zh: 这个项目关注城乡8至11岁的学童，并收集有关他们住在贫民区还是其他地区的数据。

sentences.en: Many of the children have moved from remote, rural areas to urban areas.
sentences.zh: 许多孩子都是从偏远的农村迁入城市的。

sentences.en: They are so poor they have to live in slums and, as a result of migration, they may speak languages that are different from the regional language.
sentences.zh: 他们生活贫困，只能住在贫民区；由于是从别处迁来的，他们说的语言可能有别于当地通行的语言。

sentences.en: Having already tested 1,000 children, the researchers will now embark on retesting them.
sentences.zh: 研究者已经测过这1,000名儿童，现在准备对他们进行第二轮测试。

sentences.en: They intend to look not only at test results, but also at variables such as the standard of schooling, the environment and the teaching practices themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们打算考察的不只是测试成绩，还包括办学水平、学习环境和教学方法本身等变量。

sentences.en: It's possible that one of the causes of low performance is the lack of pupil-centred teaching methods; in many Indian primary schools the teacher dominates and there is little room for independent learning.
sentences.zh: 成绩较差的一个原因可能是缺乏以学生为中心的教学方式；在印度许多小学，老师主导课堂，学生几乎没有自主学习的空间。

sentences.en: Although the findings are at a preliminary stage, Tsimpli and her team have found that the medium of instruction used in schools, especially English, may hold back those children who have little familiarity with, or exposure to, the language before starting school and outside of school life.
sentences.zh: 虽然结果还属初步，齐姆普利和团队已经发现，学校采用的教学用语，尤其是英语，可能会妨碍一部分孩子的学习。这些孩子在入学前以及平日校外生活中对这种语言不熟悉，也很少有机会接触它。

sentences.en: According to Tsimpli, most of the evidence from this and other projects shows that English instruction for children from low socio-economic areas might not be the best way for them to learn, at least in the first three years of primary education.
sentences.zh: 齐姆普利说，这项研究和其他项目的大部分证据表明，对来自社会经济条件较差地区的孩子，用英语授课未必是最有利于学习的方式，至少小学头三年如此。

sentences.en: 'What we would recommend for everyone, not just low socio-economic status children, would be to start learning in the language they feel comfortable learning in ...
sentences.zh: “我们的建议适用于每一个孩子，而不仅是社会经济地位较低的孩子：起步时，应当用他们觉得学起来最自在的语言……

sentences.en: English can still be used, but perhaps not as the medium of instruction in primary schools.
sentences.zh: 英语仍可以使用，但在小学阶段，或许不应把它当作各科的教学用语。

sentences.en: It could, for example, be one of the subjects that are being taught alongside other subjects.
sentences.zh: 例如，可以把英语列为一个科目，与其他科目并行开设。

sentences.en: We are not suggesting that English be withdrawn – that ship has sailed – but we perhaps have to think more about learner needs.
sentences.zh: 我们并不是主张取消英语教学——那早就不现实了。但我们或许应当多想想学习者的需要。

sentences.en: There is perhaps too much uniformity in teaching and less tailoring to the children's language abilities and needs,' says Tsimpli.
sentences.zh: 教学上或许一刀切得太多，却不够重视根据孩子的语言能力和需要来调整。”齐姆普利说。

sentences.en: While the preliminary results show there is no difference in general intelligence among boys and girls from slum areas versus those from urban poor backgrounds, an unanticipated finding has been that children from slum backgrounds do not seem to lag behind children from other urban poor backgrounds – and in some cases outperform them (e.g. in numeracy and literacy tasks).
sentences.zh: 初步结果显示，贫民区的男孩女孩与其他城市贫困家庭的男孩女孩相比，总体智力并无差异。有个结果却出人意料：贫民区的孩子似乎并不落后于其他城市贫困儿童，有些时候，他们甚至表现得更好，例如在算术和读写任务上。

sentences.en: According to the researchers, this unexpected finding may be down to the life experiences of children growing up in slums.
sentences.zh: 研究者认为，这项意外发现可能与孩子们在贫民区成长的生活经历有关。

sentences.en: They are likely to mature faster and come into closer contact with the numeracy skills essential for day-to-day survival.
sentences.zh: 这些孩子可能成熟得更快，也更常用到维持日常生活所必需的算术技能。

sentences.en: The project has already caught the attention of government ministers, who are keen to use the findings of the study to inform and adjust school policy in Delhi and the wider state.
sentences.zh: 这项研究已经引起政府部长们的注意。他们迫切希望借助研究结果，为德里及所在行政区域更大范围的学校政策提供依据，并作相应调整。

sentences.en: 'They are as keen as us to understand how the challenging context of deprivation can be attenuated when focusing on the languages children learn and use while at school.
sentences.zh: “他们和我们一样，很想知道：重视儿童在学校学习和使用的语言，能在多大程度上缓解贫困处境给学习带来的困难。

sentences.en: Our findings don't mean you're doomed if you're poor.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现并不意味着，穷就注定学不好。

sentences.en: It may be that these low learning outcomes are because of the way education is provided in India, with a huge focus on Hindi and English as the mediums of instruction, to the potential detriment of children unfamiliar with those languages,' explains Tsimpli.
sentences.zh: 孩子们学习成效不佳，可能源于印度的教育方式：当地高度重视以印地语和英语作为授课语言，这可能使不熟悉这两种语言的孩子处于不利地位。”齐姆普利解释说。

sentences.en: 'Language is central to the way knowledge is transferred – so the medium of instruction is obviously hugely influential.
sentences.zh: “知识如何传授，语言在其中起着核心作用。因此，选用哪种教学语言显然影响很大。

sentences.en: We hope to ... show that problem solving, numeracy and literacy can and do improve in children who are educated in a language of instruction they know.
sentences.zh: 我们希望……证明，对用自己熟悉的语言接受教学的孩子来说，解决问题、算术和读写这三类能力不仅可以提高，而且确实会提高。

sentences.en: The trick may be to bridge school skills with life skills and make use of the richness of a child's life experience to help them learn in the most effective ways possible,' says Tsimpli.
sentences.zh: 诀窍或许在于把学校所学与生活技能联系起来，并利用孩子们丰富的生活经验，帮助他们以最有效的方式学习。”齐姆普利说。
